page.overview:
What is Ethiopian Pegasi?

rightEthiopian Pegasi were a breed of winged horses, or Pegasi, that had a more goat-like appearance. They had large brown wings with brown fur all over their body. They had large horns as well, a trait that Pegasi don't usually have. The Ethiopian Pegasi is mentioned by Pliny the Elder in Natural History 8.72.
